raw_text:
Here’s the complete 12-week general strength program summary, integrating strength, core, cardio, anti-inflammatory nutrition, and sleep/recovery. It honors: no heavy axial loading and no loaded spinal flexion for his L4–L5 history.

Structure overview
- Duration: 12 weeks
- Frequency: 3 strength sessions/week (Mon/Wed/Fri example), 60–70 minutes
- Cardio: 2 sessions/week, 25–40 minutes (Tue/Sat)
- Core: 2–3 mini-blocks/week (8–15 minutes), built into lifting days
- Phases:
  • Phase 1 Weeks 1–4: Foundation, motor control, tissue capacity  
  • Phase 2 Weeks 5–8: Progressive strength with higher intensity (updated)  
  • Phase 3 Weeks 9–12: Consolidation, power/capacity, taper and testing
- Guardrails: neutral spine, no Valsalva, pain-free ROM, hinges conservative; prioritize machines, goblet/belt squat, landmine, cables, sleds, chest-supported rows. Progress 2.5–5% only if RPE ≤7–7.5 and fully symptom-free during/after/next day.

Warm-up each lift day (10–12 minutes)
- 3 minutes light cardio
- Mobility: cat-camel (gentle), half-kneeling hip flexor with posterior tilt, 90/90 hip rotations, ankle rocks, T-spine open books (6–8/side)
- Activation: dead bug 6–8/side; band pull-aparts 12–15; side-lying clam 10/side; bodyweight box squat 8

Phase 1: Weeks 1–4 (Foundation; RPE ~6–7)
Week 1
Session A
- Leg press 3x10
- Seated cable row 3x10
- DB incline press 3x8–10
- Half-kneeling cable chop 2x10/side
- Cable pull-through (light) 2x12
- Side plank 2x20–30s/side
- Finish: easy bike 6 min

Session B
- Goblet box squat (high box) 3x8–10
- Lat pulldown 3x10
- Chest-supported row 3x10
- Reverse lunge (light) 2–3x8/side
- Pallof press 2x10/side (2–3s hold)
- Glute bridge 3x12
- Farmer carry (light) 3x20–30 m

Session C
- Single-leg press 3x8/side
- Seated machine shoulder press 3x8–10 (neutral grip)
- Incline chest-supported DB row 3x10
- Step-up (low box) 2–3x8/side
- Face pull 2x12–15
- Dead bug (heel taps) 3x6–8/side
- Sled push (light) 5x20 m

Week 2
- Repeat Week 1; +2.5–5% or +1 rep where RPE ≤7. Add 1 set to first lower-body move in Sessions A and B.

Week 3
Session A: Leg press 4x8–10; Seated row 3x8–10; DB incline press 4x8; Pull-through 3x10–12; Half-kneeling anti-rotation 3x8/side (3s); Side plank 3x25–35s/side; Bike 8 min.
Session B: Goblet box squat 4x6–8; Lat pulldown 3x8–10; Chest-supported row 3x8–10; Reverse lunge 3x8/side; Glute bridge (feet on bench optional) 3x10; Farmer carry 4x20–30 m.
Session C: Single-leg press 3x8–10/side; Seated machine shoulder press 3x8; Incline DB row 3x8–10; Step-up 3x8/side; Face pull 3x12–15; Dead bug 3x8–10/side; Sled push 6x20 m.

Week 4 (Deload)
- Drop ~25% volume (remove 1 set per lift), keep technique tempo 2-0-2; maintain core.

Phase 2: Weeks 5–8 (Progressive strength, intensity pushed; hinges capped ≤RPE 7.5)
Global
- Primaries: top set at RPE 8–8.5 after build-up, then back-offs at RPE 7–7.5. Rest 2–3 min on primaries, 60–90 s accessories.

Week 5
Session A
- Leg press: build 2x5 @ RPE 6–7; top 1x5 @ 8–8.5; back-off 2x6 @ 7–7.5
- DB RDL to mid-shin (3s eccentric) 3x6–8 @ RPE 7
- Split squat 3x6–8/side @ RPE 7–8
- 45° back extension to neutral 2x12 @ RPE 6–7
- Side plank with top-leg abduction 2x25–35s/side
- Sled push 6x25–30 m @ RPE 7

Session B
- One-arm cable row 4x6–8/side @ RPE 7–8
- DB floor press: build 1x6 @ 6–7; top 1x6 @ 8; back-off 2x6–8 @ 7–7.5
- Landmine press (half-kneeling) 3x6–8/side @ RPE 7–8
- Chest-supported row 3x8 @ RPE 7–8
- Pallof press to overhead 2x8/side (2–3s holds)
- Farmer carry 4x30–35 m challenging, posture-perfect

Session C
- Goblet or belt squat: build 1x6 @ 6–7; top 1x6 @ 8; back-off 2x6–8 @ 7–7.5
- Cable pull-through 3x10 @ RPE 7
- Lat pulldown 4x6–8 @ RPE 7–8
- Machine lateral raise 2–3x12–15 (last set ~RPE 8)
- Dead bug with band pulldown 3x8/side

Week 6
- Progress 2.5–5% if Week 5 was ≤RPE 7.5 on back-offs. Add 1 back-off set to leg press and goblet/belt squat.
- Optional hinge swap: trap-bar block pull (high handles/2–3″ blocks) 4x4–5 @ RPE 6.5–7.5 only if 100% symptom-free; otherwise keep DB RDL.
- Carries: increase to 35–45 m/set.

Week 7
Session A
- Leg press: build 2x4 @ 6–7; top 1x4 @ 8–8.5; back-off 3x5 @ 7–7.5
- Trap-bar block pull or DB RDL 4x4–6 @ ≤7.5
- Split squat 3x6/side, last set ~RPE 8
- 45° back extension 3x10 @ RPE 7
- Side plank 3x30–40s/side
- Sled push 6x30–40 m @ RPE 7–8

Session B
- One-arm cable row 5x5–6/side @ RPE 7–8
- DB floor press: build 1x5 @ 6–7; top 1x5 @ 8–8.5; back-off 2x6 @ 7–7.5
- Landmine press (tall-kneeling) 3x5–6/side @ RPE 7–8
- Chest-supported row 3x6–8 @ RPE 7–8
- Pallof press 3x8/side (3s holds)
- Farmer carry heavy 4x40 m

Session C
- Goblet/belt squat: build 1x5 @ 6–7; top 1x5 @ 8–8.5; back-off 3x5–6 @ 7–7.5
- Cable pull-through 3x8–10 @ RPE 7–8
- Lat pulldown 4x5–6 @ RPE 7–8
- Machine lateral raise 3x10–12 @ RPE 8
- Dead bug 3x8–10/side

Week 8 (Deload/technique)
- Cut volume 30–35%, skip top sets; hinges light (DB RDL 2x8 @ RPE 5–6). Sled/carries @ RPE 6.

Phase 3: Weeks 9–12 (Consolidation, power/capacity, taper and 1RM testing)
Week 9
Session A (Lower + power)
- Med-ball chest pass 4x5 (light, no twist)
- Leg press 5x5, last set ~RPE 8
- Trap-bar block pull or DB RDL 4x5 (≤RPE 7)
- Split squat 3x6/side
- Copenhagen side plank (short lever) 2x15–20s/side
- Sled push 6x30–40 m

Session B (Upper)

- Landmine press (tall-kneeling) 4x6/side
- DB incline press 3x6–8
- Chest-supported row 3x8
- Face pull 3x12–15

Session C (Full body)

- Cable pull-through 3x10–12
- Lat pulldown 4x6
- Machine lateral raise 3x12
- Dead bug with foam roller 3x8/side
- Farmer carry 4x40 m

Week 10
- +2.5–5% on major lifts if smooth. Keep hinges ≤RPE 7. Optional tall-kneeling rotational med-ball throw 3x5/side only if pain-free; otherwise repeat chest pass.

Week 11
Session A
- Med-ball chest pass 4x5
- Leg press 5x4–5, two top sets ~RPE 8
- Trap-bar block pull or DB RDL 4x4–5 (≤RPE 7)
- Reverse lunge (DBs) 3x6/side
- Copenhagen side plank 3x20s/side
- Sled push 6x40 m

Session B
- One-arm cable row 5x5/side
- Landmine press 4x5/side
- DB incline press 3x5–6
- Chest-supported row 3x6–8
- Face pull 3x12
- Pallof press 3x8/side

Session C

- Lat pulldown 4x5–6

- Dead bug 3x8–10/side
- Farmer carry 4x40–50 m

Week 12 (Taper + testing)
Mon (Primer, 35–45 min)
- Leg press 3x3 @ ~60% W11 load (speed focus)
- DB floor press 3x3 @ ~60%
- Lat pulldown 2x5 @ ~60%
- Core: Dead bug 2x6/side, Pallof press 2x15s/side
- Optional 10–15 min Zone 2 cardio

Wed
- Rest or 15–20 min easy cardio + mobility

Fri (Testing day; order and protocols)
- Warm-up: 3–5 min easy cardio; mobility flow; activation as above
- Leg press 1RM
  • Warm-ups: empty 10; 50% x5; 60% x3; 75% x2; 85% x1; 92–95% x1
  • Attempts: 97–100% x1; then +2.5–5% for 1–2 more if smooth (terminate if grind >4 s or form drift)
- DB floor press 1RM (spotter) or 3RM if solo
  • Warm-ups to 85% x1; then 2–3 singles (or 1 top 3–5RM set) with 0.5 s pause on floor
- Landmine press 1RM/side (half- or tall-kneeling)
  • Warm-ups to 85% x1; then 2–3 singles adding 2.5–5 lb if crisp
- Lat pulldown 3–5RM (true RPE 9–9.5, no torso swing)
- Hinge technical 3RM (trap-bar block pull or DB RDL) at RPE ≤8; abort with any low-back awareness beyond hamstrings/glutes

Sat/Sun: Rest, walks, gentle mobility

Cardio plan (2x/week, low-impact)
Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4)
- 25–35 min Zone 2 (RPE 3–5) both days; add 3 x 20–30 s brisk pickups from Week 3.

Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8)
- Session A: 35 min Zone 2
- Session B: Intervals sub-threshold
  • Warm-up 8–10 min
  • 6–8 x 1 min @ RPE 6–7 with 2 min easy between
  • Cool-down 5 min (total ~30–35 min)

Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12)
- Session A: 35–40 min Zone 2 + 4–6 x 20–30 s strides late in session
- Session B: Threshold-lite intervals
  • Warm-up 8–10 min
  • 5–6 x 2 min @ RPE 7 with 2–3 min easy
  • Cool-down 5–7 min (Week 12: Zone 2 only; no intervals)

Core/“abs” plan (2–3x/week; 8–15 minutes)
Weeks 1–4
- Core A: Dead bug (heel taps) 3x8/side; Side plank (knees) 3x20–30s/side; Pallof hold 3x20s/side
- Core B: High plank 3x20–30s; Bird dog 3x6–8/side (2s hold); Suitcase carry 3x25 m/side

Weeks 5–8
- Core A: Dead bug (opposite arm/leg) 3x6–8/side; Side plank (full) 3x25–40s/side; Pallof reps 3x8–10/side (2–3s holds)
- Core B: Long-lever plank 3x15–25s; Band-resisted bird dog 3x6/side; Suitcase carry heavier 4x30–40 m/side

Weeks 9–12
- Core A: Swiss ball dead bug 3x6–8/side; Side plank + top-leg abduction 3x15–25s/side; Pallof to overhead 3x6–8/side
- Core B: Swiss ball rollout 3x6–10 (or ab wheel from knees 2–3x4–8 if truly symptom-free); Copenhagen plank (short lever) 3x12–20s/side; Farmer carry 4x40–50 m

Anti-inflammatory nutrition (ongoing)
- Protein 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day; 25–40 g/meal
- Produce 7–10 servings/day; 4+ colors
- Fiber 30–40 g/day
- Fats: EVOO primary; fish 2–3x/week or 1–2 g/day EPA+DHA; nuts/seeds daily; limit deep-fried and omega-6-heavy refined oils
- Carbs: mostly low–moderate GI; 30–60 g pre-lift and 60–90 g post-lift with 30–50 g protein
- Fluids: 30–35 ml/kg/day; limit alcohol ≤3 drinks/week
- Spices/herbs: turmeric+black pepper, ginger, garlic, cinnamon, rosemary, oregano
- Simple weekly habits: fish 2–3x/week, 2+ cups leafy greens/day, 1–2 tbsp flax/chia most days, alcohol-free weekdays, 8–10k steps/day

Sleep and recovery protocol (ongoing)
- 7.5–9 hours/night; consistent schedule
- Wind-down 30–60 min: dim lights, light mobility, breathing, prep for tomorrow, cool/dark/quiet bedroom
- Caffeine cut-off 8–10 hours pre-bed; alcohol none or minimal; dinner 2–3 hours pre-bed
- Morning light within 30–60 minutes; break up sitting hourly
- Daily 5-minute diaphragmatic breathing; optional 10-minute relaxation post-dinner
- Deloads in Weeks 4, 8, 12; space intervals 24+ hours from hardest lower-body lift
- Readiness check each morning; cap day at RPE 7 and cut accessories if two metrics ≤3/5
- Week 11–12: bank 30–60 extra minutes sleep/night; Week 12 keep cardio easy and follow testing protocols

Key substitutions (if needed)
- If goblet/belt squat irritates: hack squat shallow ROM or high-box squat
- If DB RDL/trap-bar bothers back: cable pull-through, hip thrust/bridges, hamstring curls
- If overhead pressing irritates: landmine press, machine press, incline DB press
- Favor chest-supported rows to unload spine

Expected outcomes by Week 12
- Increased leg press and goblet/belt squat strength (10–20% typical)
- Improved unilateral strength and core endurance with no symptom flare-ups
- Better aerobic base and interval tolerance
- Successful leg press 1RM, strong landmine/DB floor press maxes, and a safe technical hinge 3RM to guide the next block

This summary gives you a week-by-week roadmap with integrated cardio, core, nutrition, sleep, and a final-week test while staying within spinal safety guardrails.
